ev.q: COVID-19 was diagnosed in 4,913 (approximately 3%) workers, and 20 COVID-19–related deaths were reported.
Among 17 states reporting the number of workers in their affected facilities, 3.0% of 130,578 workers received diagnoses of COVID-19.
Among approximately 130,000 workers at these facilities, 4,913 cases and 20 deaths occurred.
The percentage of workers with diagnosed COVID-19 ranged from 0.6% to 18.2%.
During April 9–27, aggregate data on COVID-19 cases among 115 meat or poultry processing facilities in 19 states were reported to CDC.

methods_quotes.q: Excludes cases from Pennsylvania and Tennessee because number of workers (denominator) is not available from these states.
States reported COVID-19 among workers using their own case definitions.
